_schema_doc: Goal profiles for context-dependent reward shaping. Each goal is a strategic mode the scripted top-level planner can select (e.g. 'crafting_super_smoothie'). While that goal is active, item values are multiplied by the profile's `value_modifiers`. Missing items default to 1.0 (base value unchanged). Goals are activated by conditions the routine planner detects — HUD state, inventory levels, time of day.

default_farming.description: General farming with no specific goal — grab items at base value.

expanding_hive.description: Focus on growing bee count. Wants honey + jellies + eggs.

bond_farming_target_bee.description: Actively leveling a specific bee. Treats and radioactive-making become primary.

crafting_super_smoothie.description: Building ingredients for a Super Smoothie (3 Neonberry + 3 Star Jelly + 3 Purple Potion + 6 Tropical Drink).

boost_session_active.description: In the middle of a 15-min boost. Ability tokens are king — grab them fast.

boss_prep_and_fight.description: About to fight or fighting a boss. Combat buffs matter most.

daily_routine.description: Doing daily tasks — Wealth Clock, Memory Match, Mondo Chick, Ticket Tent visits.

planter_cycle.description: Managing planters — placing, harvesting, applying glue/gumdrops.

beequip_upgrading.description: Applying waxes to beequips, farming wax mats.

night_activities.description: Night is active — Werewolf, Rogue Vicious Bee, Moon-related loot.

endgame_grinding.description: Late game (35+ bees). Rare mats dominate — waxes, Star Jelly, endgame amulet farming.
